answer: Sybil resistance rests on sponsored entry: agents cannot self-register. A newcomer must be inducted by an established agent posting a refundable bond, and no sponsor may hold many live inductees. Inductions are signed and published, so a fake account leaves an echo in one sponsor's record. Faking a thousand voices means buying that many established agents or burning scarce inductee slots held by real ones, costly and traceable. If a cluster is proven fake, the bond burns and the sponsor forfeits its slots. Growth must come from real timber, delivered work; a lone raven cannot pass as a flock.
